title: Implement the complete signed-dyadic scaling API with physical owner return
body:
The helper462/frame506 route in PR #4989 has 80 literal `unit_scale` sites, using five signed-dyadic coefficients. This supplies that complete operation class: multiplication by `2`, `1/2`, `-1`, `-2`, and `-1/2` modulo every runtime positive odd `Q`, for arbitrary complete `[P] × [Q] × [S]` Boolean streams. The source family has `80f²` sites when `N = 8f`.

Ten fixed programs use 14 tapes and 7 symbols. Each coefficient has a source-preserving output interface and an in-place interface that returns the result to the **same original physical owner**. The latter gathers the entire source before overwriting it, consumes both buckets, and returns every private cell and head to its original blank state. It pays for all storage, copies, record motion, rewinds, setup and erasure. Negative maps preserve the order of bits inside each record. No scalar inverse, bank relabelling or source-retirement oracle is assumed.

`PROOF.md` gives uniform conservative bounds of **2048V transitions and 64V visited cells**, where `V = PQS`, including signed composition and erased intermediate work. At site volumes `V_j`, the completed scaling contribution is at most `2048 Σ V_j`, with sequentially reusable private capacity `64 max V_j`. These are sufficient physical charges, not optimized invoice terms.

The family decision is **NARROW** to this completed operation inventory. The remaining 224f² ordered shifts, 80f² ordinary high swaps, low-controlled carries/commits, canonical native invocation, ROW/cache lifetime, descriptor/header and packet-layout producers, whole #4814 matcher coverage, and P3/stock/precision/supplier admission retain their full unknown costs. Installing the supplied complete-stream representation in an actual recursive owner bank remains a caller obligation. This changes no paid-call count, selected result or κ.

Validation at `02a3cedb301e072bc5d991c7e36086daa8cd5c40`:

- All five registered commands pass under Python 3.12.2, including normal and optimized execution through both retained PR #2776 engines.
- 560 coefficient/interface executions, 16,040 payload bits, all 80 literal source sites at actual `Q = 125` with compressed spectators, and 30 complete physical in-place inverse roundtrips pass. These fixtures do not materialize the enormous complete source cover.
- Fourteen semantic controls and seven relocated CLI tests reject source/table/typed-receipt corruption and three regenerated code mutants that omit a Q-counter return, the original-owner rewind, or negative-prefix cursor positioning.
- Source-history/ancestry checks, `git diff --check`, and the official 19-file export pass. All five registered commands also pass from the extracted export with Git unavailable and every exported byte unchanged.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/signed-dyadic-scaling
```

The authenticated predecessors remain unchanged: PR #2776 machine/counter/copy/erasure macros and both disjoint execution engines; PR #4989 PROGRAM, generator, interpreter and proof at base `f259dabc7d70e0db8d6d36bfda888f008bbfecc1`. Pending PR #5019 at `39f3cf9fb4f2e495a716c7b501ea3bceb6b2a748` is credited as complementary affine-shear context only, with no code or Git-object dependency. The package retains David Arias, Charles Bethin, Jose Manuel, ai-nanachi, Chris R/Clear1nsight and the native/ROW/ordinary/stock/routing/precision/tape lineage credits. JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1317#discussioncomment-19140224

No Lean, Docker, full selected-certificate replay, full caller materialization, independent human proof review or formal proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. Complete unresolved contracts and open next questions are recorded in the package.
